text:
President Trump says he signed six pardons for people “who were persecuted by the Biden administration.”

There was some reporting that he was considering 250 pardons for America’s 250th birthday.
translated_text:
特朗普总统表示，他签署了对“受拜登政府迫害”的六人的赦免。

有报道称，他正在考虑在美国 250 岁生日之际赦免 250 人。
